notes.title: Steam Summer Sale - Discounts Up to 35% OFF
notes.notes:
It's that time again! All our games are at a discount for the Steam Summer Sale:

[b]Melancholy Love -[/b] A Yuri Visual Novel between an elite and a misfit in an All-Girls' High School. How will sparks flare between the two?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1387460/Melancholy_Love/

[b]Dandelions In The Sky - [/b]A new student with a mysterious past, and a girl isolated and bullied by her peers. What secrets are they hiding?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1238520/Dandelions_in_the_Sky/

[b]Caffeine: Victoria's Legacy[/b] - A choice-rich, fantasy adventure visual novel in a steampunk Victorian alternate reality, where coffee is all that matters.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/890700/Caffeine_Victorias_Legacy/

[b]Snowdome -[/b] For Tan Yan, there is little hope his life will change. It's like his whole life is trapped inside a snowdome, unable to escape. But, what if, one day, he's given the chance to make a change?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1131740/Snowdome/

[b]The Warmth Between Us  -[/b] It is late December in Taipei. The pavement glows like silver under the winter rain. That's when we met for the first time. The warmth between us has a certain comfort that I’ve never felt before.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1203970/The_Warmth_Between_Us/
